purpose: Held-out test of the reviewed planning pipeline (plan, review, at most one re-plan) on the four retained moments, before any image. No images, no production writes.
authorization: Owner approved option (b) on 2026-10-23; this measures it on fresh replies. Charged to the existing evaluation allowance.

pipeline.review: Claude Haiku 5.5, reasoning low, 4,000-token ceiling; planning reasoning off

execution: This repository's prepareMoment at the pipeline commit runs locally over a fresh in-memory store per sample, seeded from one read-only snapshot of production generation 1 with the four moments' plan records removed. Looks, sections, entries and moments are stored production records. Production is read once; nothing is written there. Production adapter, routing and default sampling.

samples.order: Round r = 1..5, each moment in listed order.

retryPolicy: Each sample is one ordinary prepareMoment: its own malformed-reply retries, one review per plan, and at most one re-plan. No other rerun, response edit or replacement sample. A provider error, missing usage, uncertain outcome, unexpected look request or exhausted reserve stops the run; untaken samples are reported missing.

rubric.source: Identical to ../2026-10-23-grounding-rate-check/plan.json rubric (U, X, I, F blockers; N note).
rubric.scoredText: For a stored sample, the stored plan's scene fields and present ids (what reaches rendering). For a refused sample, the last plan reply's fields, for diagnosis only. The outcome, number of rounds, review problems and grounding audit are withheld.
rubric.pass: The sample stored a plan and that plan has none of U, X, I or F.
rubric.scorers: A fresh subagent and the operator, each scoring all 20 blind before the key is read. Disagreements resolved by the operator with a recorded rationale before unblinding.

interpretation.note: n=5 per moment; differences of one or two passes are within ordinary variation.
interpretation.converging: At least 4 of 5 passes on every moment: recommend the visual step, which needs an evaluation budget increase.
interpretation.notConverging: At most 2 of 5 on some moment: the reviewed pipeline still cannot plan that moment reliably; report for the owner.
interpretation.mixed: Anything else: report per moment for the owner's decision.

alsoReported: Re-plan and refusal rates, how often the review flagged a plan, review problem kinds, per-sample preparation latency and cost. These describe the pipeline; they do not change the pass rule.
